claim_boundary: Exact point lower bounds for the frozen paired22 candidate cohort. Q-isomorphism and catalogue comparison occurs only after all attempts/replays. No exact rank, global minimality, exact conductor or universal novelty is inferred. Validation-prime enrichment and discovery yield are finite experimental outcomes.
